session_scope: intelligence/research design only; no training, no model or checkpoint modification performed

evidence_envelope_contract.finding: Real, already-implemented: trust/confidence separation, bounded evidence influence, monotonic degradation via derive(), EvidenceMode real/simulated/unavailable with a hard cached-replay guard, expressive UncertaintyBlock. This is the foundation, not a gap.

validity_gate.finding: 10-11 deterministic, fail-closed checks. Missing SensitivityBlock is treated as blocking rather than fabricated. Template for all future abstention logic.

abhiyan_decision_state.finding: Correctly layered read-only translation of ValidityGateResult; does not re-evaluate evidence.

praman.finding: Artifact/provenance registry, NOT an evidence-fusion or ledger-reasoning engine. Prior framing of PRAMAN as 'the evidence ledger' is REJECTED as a description of current code.

netra_v0_2.finding: Real, deployed, hash-verified detector. Official IoU 0.6458, PR-AUC 0.8513. Real MC20 external case: null detection (max_prob~3e-6). Cross-domain generalization not established.

netra_v0_3_b1.finding: Regressed on target domain. This session's score-distribution diagnostic classifies the failure MIXED, leaning strongly REPRESENTATION_DOMINANT (see reports/netra_v03/b1_score_diagnostic.json).

netra_ood_detector.finding: compute_score() returns np.random.uniform(0.1, 0.9) - uniform noise, not a real OOD computation. Highest-leverage cheap fix identified this session.

chhaya.finding: Real job is SAR-vs-AIS dark-vessel matching, not multi-hypothesis source attribution. NYAYA already implements most of the multi-hypothesis attribution the governing brief asked CHHAYA to do. Recommended: extend NYAYA's hypothesis space rather than build a second Bayesian engine in CHHAYA.

nyaya.finding: Real Bayesian attribution: density-based likelihoods (Phi mass density vessel-corridor vs background), real behavioral priors (speed anomaly/loiter/night proximity) with documented threshold provenance, posterior entropy + distinguishability outputs.

smriti.finding: In-memory list only, non-persistent. detect_corridors() always returns []. propose_training_batch() never auto-approved (Threat G-07, a genuinely good guardrail) but nothing consumes an approved proposal - trigger_learning_loop()'s approved branch is 'pass'. No vector store / embeddings present - a clean slate, not a legacy mistake to undo.

whatif_simulator.finding: simulate_wind_change() calls self.chhaya_service.forecast(...) but ChhayaProvider protocol has no forecast() method - dead code or latent AttributeError.

agentic_orchestration.finding: Repo-wide search for agent/orchestration/next-best-action code returned zero matches. GoldenCaseWorkflow is a fixed deterministic pipeline, not evidence-driven decisioning. Entirely greenfield.

legacy_src_tree.finding: Mirrors packages/ component names but is not imported anywhere under packages/ or apps/; last touched 2026-08-24, predates current architecture. Risk of confusing future sessions; flagged for Integration to archive/delete.

prativartan_phi.finding: Real uncertainty via SensitivityBlock (age/forcing/diffusivity sensitivity from actual parameter perturbation sweeps), consumed by the Validity Gate.

go_nogo_harness.finding: VARUNA_MASTER_CONTEXT.md self-documents an EvidenceEnvelope construction error making it scientifically invalid. Not independently re-run this session. Closest existing thing to a system benchmark; repair is a NOW/cheap-experiment candidate, not a from-scratch build.

future_research_ranked.cost: moderate-compute, sequenced after the NOW closed-form OOD fix

future_research_ranked.direction: second real external-domain validation case beyond MC20

what_we_know: EvidenceEnvelope/ValidityState/derive() form a genuinely solid, already-implemented evidence backbone (trust vs confidence, monotonic degradation, bounded influence)
NYAYA is a real, working Bayesian attribution engine (density likelihoods + behavioral priors)
PRATIVARTAN populates real sensitivity-based uncertainty, consumed by a real fail-closed Validity Gate
NETRA v0.2 is a real detector with a known, measured cross-domain failure mode (MC20 null detection)
B1's regression is MIXED/representation-dominant, not simple miscalibration (this session's diagnostic)
NETRA's OOD detector is fake (uniform random noise), CHHAYA is mock/narrow, SMRITI is mock/non-persistent, agentic orchestration does not exist, src/ is dead code
what_we_believe: CHHAYA v2 should extend NYAYA's hypothesis space rather than duplicate it with a second Bayesian engine
SMRITI should be structured (Postgres, predicate retrieval) not semantic/vector-based, given current evidence is entirely structured
The agent orchestration loop should wrap GoldenCaseWorkflow's fixed stages with one bounded decision point, not replace the workflow
what_we_do_not_know: The root cause of B1's representation collapse (MIL weight vs topk_frac vs domain gap) - requires an approved ablation to resolve
Whether NETRA's production envelope already populates QualityMetrics/UncertaintyBlock at all
Whether the go/no-go harness's construction error is a one-line fix or structural
How SMRITI retrieval should actually be tuned - insufficient real case volume exists yet to know
what_we_should_build: Real NETRA OOD score (closed-form, no training)
SMRITI v2 structured schema + write path
VARUNA benchmark v1 as a standing regression suite
what_we_should_measure: Evidence efficiency (information gathered vs information needed)
Whether the netra_ood gate check actually fires on MC20-like scenes and stays quiet on in-domain ones
Whether fusion double-counts correlated evidence sources
what_we_should_not_train_yet: No B2 or any NETRA v0.3 continuation
No topk_frac/MIL-weight ablation without the separate written justification the governing brief requires
No learned CHHAYA/SMRITI components before deterministic v1s exist and real outcome data accumulates
final_status.what_future_research_matters_most: Whether VARUNA can turn NETRA's known, measured imperfection into reliable evidence-aware decisions - concretely, whether a real OOD signal plus the widened Validity Gate actually causes the system to behave differently (degrade/restrict appropriately) on an MC20-like scene versus an in-domain one. This is the one measurement that would validate or falsify this entire document's central thesis, and it requires no training to check.
